visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed promotional banner with a background photo/image, a large heading, optional supporting paragraph, and a single CTA button. Content is either left-aligned directly over the background (default) or centered inside a rounded card panel (card option).
contentPattern: Row 1: background image. Following rows: heading, optional paragraph text, and a CTA link.
usage: Used for full-width hero and promotional banners. On the 7up homepage it appears 3 times (lime hero, store-locator card, flip-the-sip card).

options.name: card
options.description: Boxes the heading/text/CTA into a centered rounded panel over the background image.
